authorization: Owner, 16 November 2026: "Feel free to rework the texture of the staircase too".
note: The treads' stone was a photograph-like texture at eight times the native size. It is drawn at sixteen pixels as a stone flag, one to a block; the block state picks among it and five other flags (a shade deeper, a shade worn, cracked, chipped, flecked), which are new and not in the 0.4.100 catalogue. Its stairs and slabs pick among the three plain flags.
